workload: Model training, checkpoint recovery and a separate inference service

requirements.statement: Separate development and production identities and data access.
Use an approved private administration path and attributable identities.
Approve external artifact retrieval explicitly; keep training data within approved destinations.
Make temporary diagnostics access scoped, owned, reviewed and removable.
Retain retrievable administrative evidence for 90 days as a fictional business requirement, not a legal mandate.
Verify checkpoint integrity before resuming training.
Justify compute, network and storage tenant boundaries and identify privileged bypass actors.
Preserve an approved legitimate client path after hardening.

task: Ask discovery questions, compare designs, map controls to evidence and record unsupported assumptions.
